caption:
Each takes a singular verb. Always.

"Each of the paintings has a label." Read "each" as "each one" and the verb becomes obvious.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: Each takes a singular verb. Each of the paintings HAS a label. Each = each one.

youtube.title: Each and Every Take Singular Verbs (SAT Grammar)
youtube.description: Each and every are singular, so their verbs are singular too. Read "each" as "each one" to check.
